description: This Go source file implements a global registry for tag validators, type validators, and field validators used in Kubernetes code generation. It manages registration, initialization, validation extraction, and documentation for validation tags within the code generator context.

classes.name: registry
classes.description: A struct managing registered tag, type, and field validators, their initialization, and validation extraction logic.

methods.name: addTagValidator
methods.description: Adds a TagValidator to the registry, panics if already initialized or if the tag is registered twice.

methods.name: addTypeValidator
methods.description: Adds a TypeValidator to the registry, panics if already initialized.

methods.name: addFieldValidator
methods.description: Adds a FieldValidator to the registry, panics if already initialized.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the registry with context, sorts validators, and marks as initialized.

methods.name: ExtractTags
methods.description: Extracts tags from comments, filtering by registered tag names.

methods.name: ExtractValidations
methods.description: Extracts validations for a given context, running type and field validators as appropriate.

methods.name: ExtractTagValidations
methods.description: Runs tag validators on provided tags, returning validations.

methods.name: sortTagsIntoPhases
methods.description: Sorts tags into phases for validation order, separating late tags.

methods.name: Docs
methods.description: Returns documentation for all registered tags.

methods.name: Stability
methods.description: Returns the stability level of a specific tag.
